Examples

Place an Order

Place an Order

The Public Order API lets external integrations place orders at a Karma location in a single call — no tab pre-creation, no user lookup, no complex payload construction.

Endpoint

Code
POST /api/v1/public/orders/create

Authentication

All requests require an API key with the inventory.create permission:

Code
X-API-Key: karma_live_<your_key>

Contact Karma to obtain a key for your integration.

Quick Start

The simplest possible order

Code
curl -X POST https://api.karma.life/api/v1/public/orders/create \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-API-Key: karma_live_<your_key>" \
  -d '{
    "location_id": 123,
    "items": [
      { "id": 456, "quantity_cents": 100 }
    ]
  }'

That's it. A new tab is opened, a kitchen dispatch is created, and an anonymous guest is generated automatically.

Response

Code
{
  "status": "success",
  "data": {
    "kitchenDispatchId": "e01dcd36-cdec-41e5-8708-1b57d943367d",
    "dailyOrderNumber": 7,
    "tabId": "59e4ce7d-b801-4323-af9d-ba0ca4bd757a",
    "tabMemberId": "1f910733-4456-4099-ab3b-7f6bece30657",
    "items": [
      {
        "kitchen_dispatch_item_id": "63ae3dc1-...",
        "item_id": 456,
        "quantity_cents": 100,
        "price_cents": 9900,
        "variants": []
      }
    ],
    "totalAmount": 9900,
    "linkedVouchers": [],
    "invalidVouchers": [],
    "orderFlow": "OPEN_TAB",
    "paymentRequired": false
  }
}

Use the tabId in the response to add more items to the same tab before payment is collected.

Common Scenarios

Identify the guest by email

If you know the guest's email, pass it in ordering_member. If the email matches an existing Karma account it is reused — no duplicate is created. New accounts are created automatically.

Code
curl -X POST https://api.karma.life/api/v1/public/orders/create \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-API-Key: karma_live_<your_key>" \
  -d '{
    "location_id": 123,
    "ordering_member": {
      "email": "guest@example.com",
      "name": "Alex"
    },
    "items": [
      { "id": 456, "quantity_cents": 100 }
    ]
  }'

You can also identify by user_id (highest priority) or phone. If nothing is provided, a fresh anonymous guest is created for this order only.

Multiple items with variants and a voucher

A loyalty member ordering a customised burrito and a drink with a 10% welcome voucher, collected as takeaway:

Code
curl -X POST https://api.karma.life/api/v1/public/orders/create \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-API-Key: karma_live_<your_key>" \
  -d '{
    "location_id": 123,
    "order_type": "TAKEAWAY",
    "ordering_member": {
      "email": "alex@example.com",
      "name": "Alex"
    },
    "items": [
      {
        "id": 456,
        "quantity_cents": 100,
        "variants": [
          { "id": 12 },
          { "id": 34 }
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": 789,
        "quantity_cents": 100
      }
    ],
    "vouchers": ["WELCOME10"]
  }'

Add items to an existing tab

Use the tabId from a previous response to keep adding orders to the same tab:

Code
curl -X POST https://api.karma.life/api/v1/public/orders/create \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-API-Key: karma_live_<your_key>" \
  -d '{
    "location_id": 123,
    "order_destination": "TAB",
    "order_destination_id": "59e4ce7d-b801-4323-af9d-ba0ca4bd757a",
    "items": [
      { "id": 789, "quantity_cents": 100 }
    ]
  }'

Fractional quantities

quantity_cents scales by 100: 100 = 1 unit, 50 = half a unit, 200 = 2 units. Useful for weight-based or bulk items:

Code
{
  "items": [
    { "id": 456, "quantity_cents": 50 }
  ]
}

Price override

Override the catalogue price for this order only — useful for promotions or custom pricing:

Code
{
  "items": [
    { "id": 456, "quantity_cents": 100, "price_cents": 500 }
  ]
}

TypeScript / Node.js

Code
const response = await fetch('https://api.karma.life/api/v1/public/orders/create', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'X-API-Key': process.env.KARMA_API_KEY!,
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    location_id: 123,
    ordering_member: { email: 'guest@example.com' },
    items: [
      { id: 456, quantity_cents: 100 },
      { id: 789, quantity_cents: 100, variants: [{ id: 12 }] },
    ],
  }),
})

if (!response.ok) {
  const { error } = await response.json()
  throw new Error(`Order failed: ${error.code} — ${error.message}`)
}

const { data } = await response.json()
console.log('Order created:', data.kitchenDispatchId)
console.log('Tab:', data.tabId)
console.log('Total:', data.totalAmount, 'cents')

Python

Code
import httpx

response = httpx.post(
    'https://api.karma.life/api/v1/public/orders/create',
    headers={'X-API-Key': KARMA_API_KEY},
    json={
        'location_id': 123,
        'ordering_member': {'email': 'guest@example.com'},
        'items': [
            {'id': 456, 'quantity_cents': 100},
        ],
    },
)
response.raise_for_status()
data = response.json()['data']
print('Order created:', data['kitchenDispatchId'])
print('Tab:', data['tabId'])

Field Reference

Request body

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
location_idnumber✅Location to place the order at
itemsarray✅Items to order (at least one)
ordering_memberobject—Guest identity. Omit for an anonymous guest.
vouchersstring[]—Voucher codes to apply
order_destinationstring—NONE (default, fresh tab), TAB, QR, KD
order_destination_idstring—UUID of the target when order_destination ≠ NONE
order_typestring—OTC (default), TAKEAWAY, TABLE

items[]

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
idnumber✅Inventory item ID
quantity_centsnumber✅Quantity × 100 (100 = 1, 50 = half)
variantsobject[]—Variant selections (size, milk type, etc.)
price_centsnumber—Price override. Defaults to catalogue price.
coursing_ordernumber—Course number. 0 = send immediately.

ordering_member

FieldTypeDescription
user_idnumberExisting Karma user ID (highest priority)
emailstringFinds or creates a guest by email
phonestringFinds or creates a guest by phone
namestringDisplay name for new guests

Error codes

StatusCodeWhen
400INVALID_INPUTMissing required fields or bad types
401MISSING_API_KEYNo X-API-Key header
403INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONSKey lacks inventory.create
403SCOPE_VIOLATIONKey not scoped to this location
422ITEM_NOT_FOUNDItem does not exist at this location
422ITEM_UNAVAILABLEItem is currently unavailable
429RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDEDToo many requests
